design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Treat runoff from 90% of average-year storms (goal: 80% average annual post-development TSS reduction). WQv = (Rv)×(A)×(P)/12 where P is the 90% cumulative frequency rainfall depth (~0.5–1.25 in by climatic region).
approved_bmp_categories: Extended Storage Pond / Dry ED Ponds

design_parameters.enrich_notes: WQv uses P from local 90% storm or snowmelt analysis; Coastal/Southeast example uses 1.25 in rainfall (Interior examples use 0.5 in rain or 1.2 in melt). Unified sizing also cites P roughly 0.5–1.25 in and annual rainfall note up to 1.25–1.75 in. Juneau aligns with Coastal region feasibility tables. Oil/grit separators need 50% TSS removal for particles >20 µm under 2-year, 6-hour event (ADEC non-objection), not a numeric MTD verification program.
